Approved rework runs only on WMS rework task after approval and is released only as fully compliant, newly labelled stock. Open returns, inspections in progress, quarantine bookings and pending dispositions are recorded in the shift file and carried into handover as open, and reported to the client with reference, quantities, condition, proposal and approval given or pending, with blocked quantities shown separately as unavailable to promise.

title: Temperature-Controlled Storage
text:
1. We store temperature-controlled client stock only in Zone E, the enclosed chilled store of 300 m2. The store is held continuously between +2 °C and +8 °C, with refrigeration, continuous electronic monitoring and audible alarms active at all times, including nights, shift changeovers at 06:00, 14:00 and 22:00, approved Saturday morning overtime, and stocktake freeze. No ambient goods, hazmat, quarantine stock, packing materials or empty pallets are stored in Zone E.

2. Only booked cold-chain goods enter Zone E under PR-02 and PR-12. We collect pallets in Zone A only after the system receipt is posted with temperature evidence, batch and expiry where required, and a scan-verified WMS pallet licence plate fixed. Pallets without a verified label, with missing data, or with unresolved document discrepancies stay in Zone A and are never moved to the cold zone. Each placement respects the site-wide limit of 800 kg per pallet including load and is scan-confirmed at pallet and location.

3. We apply a per-shift verification standard without exception. Each shift our team reads the independent calibrated thermometer, compares it with the continuous monitor, confirms alarms active, checks doors self-closing with seals intact, lights working and no ice, water, odour or packaging failure, and records time, both readings, name and any alarm in the cold log. The shift supervisor in charge does not release Zone E moves until the verification is recorded. Verification covers mornings 06:00–14:00 and afternoons 14:00–22:00, Monday to Friday, plus any approved Saturday overtime.

4. Doors are kept closed except for the move or check in progress. Entry for put-away from Zone A, replenishment to Zone C faces, daily cycle counts and verification is one pallet or one team at a time, with doors confirmed shut after each pass. Cold moves go first and direct by the closed route from Zone A to Zone E and from Zone E to Zone C or Zone D, without staging in Zone B or F, on dock ramps, in Zone A lanes, in ambient aisles or in Zone D staging.

5. Replenishment and picking for chilled orders are fed only from released, in-temperature stock on WMS task. We retrieve the tasked source pallet in Zone E, confirm article, batch and expiry with scan, place within the marked cold face quantity without overfilling, and pick only from those faces between +2 °C and +8 °C. Cold faces are never topped up on judgement and overstock remains in Zone E. Zone E is included in the daily rotating cycle-count schedule and counted in place without breaking control.

6. Any deviation stops all work in Zone E at once. Excursion outside +2 °C to +8 °C, alarm, power or refrigeration fault, door left open or not sealing, ice build-up, water ingress or suspect packaging stops put-away, replenishment and picking from Zone E. We secure the doors, retain stock inside, and escalate immediately to the shift supervisor, stock controllers and maintenance technician. Affected units are never re-cooled and re-racked, and replenishment resumes only from stock confirmed in-temperature.

7. Temperature-abused, leaking, thaw-suspect or expired units leave the cold chain the same day they are found under PR-09. We label date, location, reference and fault, move the same day to quarantine in Zone F services and control, enter the move in the quarantine record as system-blocked stock unavailable to promise, and never pick such units for orders. No adjustment in Zone E is posted without a mandatory independent second count, and quarantine stock is held under stock-controller block until final disposition is approved.

8. We report chilled storage on the day it is verified and on the day it fails. The client receives verification time and readings, any alarm or excursion with duration, location and stock affected, quarantine moves with reference and quantities held, and proposal and approval given or pending, with blocked quantities shown separately as unavailable to promise. Open verifications, excursions, blocked locations and sensor, door or alarm repairs are carried forward as open in the cold log, shift file and handover, with full audit trail from receipt, licence plates, count logs and quarantine records available until review and release are complete.
